scripts.lint:esm: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const check=(d)=>{const files=fs.readdirSync(d);for(const f of files){const fp=p.join(d,f);if(fs.statSync(fp).isDirectory())check(fp);else if(f.endsWith('.ts')||f.endsWith('.js')){const c=fs.readFileSync(fp,'utf8');if(/\brequire\(|module\.exports\b/.test(c)){console.error('Found CommonJS in:',fp);process.exit(1);}}}};check('src');console.log('ESM check passed');"
scripts.smoke:health: node -e "process.env.PORT='8788';process.env.SWIFT_FORWARD_BASE='http://example.com';import('./dist/index.js').then(async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000));const r=await fetch('http://localhost:8788/health');const h=await r.json();if(h.mode!=='forward')throw new Error('Expected forward mode');console.log('health-smoke-ok');process.exit(0);});"
